_scope: The GET /config form's integrator select (8 options), in curated display order rather than form order. Raw name -> family label, variant label (null throughout: no subgroup would hold more than one member), leaf label. Family is the integrator structure, leaf is the rest. The manual's kHz figures stay out of the leaves: they are stated re DSD64 source rate and scale with it, so a bare number in a row would be wrong at every other source rate. The caveat itself lives in the control's settings.json tooltip. A fourth field, `short`, is the closed-dropdown title: family and leaf composed with ` · `. Leaf labels unique within their family; short titles unique across the list.

families.Conventional: Bits build up over time like a running total that rises and falls
families.Weighted averaging: Bits are calculated from their neighbors, with closer bits counting more
families.Simple averaging: Bits are generated by repeated averaging
